verdict_note: Strong D2C funnel, GTM, and analytical chops; GEO expertise is a rare plus; lacks direct advertiser/merchant platform experience and performance marketing depth.

breakdown.note: AGM + SPM titles map to Growth Lead level; P&L ownership and 60+ team leadership demonstrate readiness; less pure 'growth lead' title history but strategic + execution experience present.

Strong: funnel analysis, A/B testing, CRM, KPI dashboards, acquisition strategy, onboarding, cross-functional leadership. Gaps: no stated performance marketing, CAC/LTV/payback metrics, or paid acquisition channel expertise (SEM, display, social).

EdTech D2C funnel ownership transfers well; GEO research is directly relevant to 'organic search (SEO & GEO)' requirement. No advertiser/merchant platform, ad tech, or SMB software (Google Ads, Meta, Shopify, HubSpot) experience stated.

38% CAC improvement, 40% retention uplift, 27% conversion lift, 19% revenue growth, P&L ownership across 5 markets—concrete metrics. Weakness: no evidence of scaling self-serve platforms or advertiser/creator monetization funnels.

Requires H1B sponsorship; OpenAI is a large, well-funded company with clear sponsorship capacity. MBA + MS in Digital Technology (May 2027) shows commitment to US-based career. Risk: timing (still in school) may complicate start date.

missing_keywords: Performance marketing / SEM / paid acquisition channels
CAC, LTV, payback period, spend expansion metrics
Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok for Business, Amazon Ads ecosystem
Self-serve / product-led growth (PLG) at scale in ads/payments
top_signal: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) research + framework built across 7 AI platforms is a rare, directly relevant differentiator for OpenAI's 'organic search (SEO & GEO)' channel; combined with proven D2C funnel diagnosis (leaky top-of-funnel), redesign, and 38% CAC improvement, shows both strategic insight and execution velocity.
biggest_gap: No direct experience with advertiser acquisition, performance marketing (paid social, SEM, display), or self-serve ad platform funnels (Google Ads, Meta, TikTok for Business, etc.); EdTech D2C does not map cleanly to the SMB advertiser motion, and there is no evidence of CAC, LTV, payback, or spend expansion metrics in practice—all core to the role.
